requirements.requirement_text: Cloudflare documents HTTP Worker duration as connection-dependent, `waitUntil()` as a bounded short extension (up to 30 seconds), and Queues as **at-least-once** delivery. Therefore a minutes-long or disconnected-background agent task MUST NOT be implemented as `waitUntil` alone or assumed to execute exactly once because it uses Queues. Use a durable job with admitted attempt, recovery cursor, heartbeat, bounded tool stages, cancellation and persistent results. Long-running provider continuation is polled/resumed through the existing job plane, not through a second inference scheduler. No global migration gate: old and new transport families may coexist while sharing canonical job identity.
